episodes.title: 学校生活
episodes.desc: 课表、科目、作业与校园活动怎么说

lines.zh: 欢迎收听初中英语散步播客第二集，学校生活。你会听到同学之间聊课程、作业和社团活动，这些都是中考听力的常考场景。

lines.en: Hi Tom. What class do you have this afternoon?
We have maths and English. What about you?
We have Chinese and history. History is my favourite subject.
Really? My favourite subject is PE. I like playing basketball.
Do you have much homework today?
Not much. I have to finish a maths exercise and read a short passage.
I have a lot of homework. I must study for the English test tomorrow.
Good luck! I'm sure you can do well.

lines.zh: 这段对话里，问课程用 What class do you have。表示最喜欢的科目，用 My favourite subject is 加上科目名。祝别人好运说 Good luck，鼓励别人可以说 I'm sure you can do well，意思是我相信你能做得很好。

lines.en: Excuse me, when does the school library open?
It opens at eight in the morning and closes at five in the afternoon.
Can I borrow books there?
Yes, you can borrow three books at a time. You can keep them for two weeks.
That's great. Do we have a reading club?
Yes. The reading club meets every Friday afternoon in Room 302.
I'd like to join it. Who is the teacher in charge?
Miss Chen. She is very friendly. You will like her.

lines.zh: 第二段对话是关于图书馆和社团的。借书用 borrow，归还用 return。加入社团用 join，比如 join the reading club 就是加入读书社。询问时间用 when，询问地点用 where。

lines.en: My school day starts at seven thirty.
I get to school at seven fifty.
We have four classes in the morning and three in the afternoon.
Between classes we have a short break.
I often talk with my friends during the break.
Lunch is at twelve.
We eat in the school dining hall.
After school, I sometimes play football with my classmates.
I usually get home at about six o'clock.
Then I do my homework and read some English stories.

lines.zh: 这段独白描述了一天的学校生活。注意几个时间表达：at seven thirty 是七点三十，about six o'clock 是大约六点。表示有时用 sometimes，通常 usually，经常 often。

lines.en: What class do you have today?
My favourite subject is English.
I have a lot of homework.
Can I borrow this book?
The library opens at eight.
I'd like to join the reading club.

lines.zh: 跟着读一遍这几个句子，注意 borrow 和 join 的发音。
下面我们把刚才听过的内容放慢速度再放一遍，这次你可以跟着一起说。

lines.en: What class do you have today?
My favourite subject is English.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢的科目是英语。

lines.en: I have a lot of homework.
Can I borrow this book?
The school library opens at eight.
I'd like to join the reading club.
Good luck with your test.
We have a short break between classes.
lines.zh: 课间我们有短暂的休息。

lines.en: I must study for the English test.
lines.zh: 我必须为英语考试复习。

lines.en: I usually get home at six.

lines.zh: 小任务来了。请用英语说出你最喜欢的科目，并说明原因。比如 My favourite subject is English because it is interesting。试试看。
第二集到这里。今天我们聊了课程、作业、图书馆和社团。下一集说说每天的作息，怎么用英语描述你的一天。我们下次见。

episodes.title: 我的日常
episodes.desc: 起床、吃饭、上学、睡觉，一天怎么说

lines.zh: 欢迎收听第三集，我的日常。描述一天的作息是初中英语最常考的写作和口语题目之一。听完这一集，你就能用英语讲清楚你的一天了。

lines.en: I get up at six thirty every morning.
First I wash my face and brush my teeth.
Then I have breakfast.
I usually have bread, an egg and a glass of milk.
At seven o'clock I go to school by bike.
It takes me about twenty minutes.
School starts at eight.
I have lunch at school at twelve.
I get home at five thirty in the afternoon.
After dinner I do my homework.
It usually takes me two hours.
Then I take a shower and read a book.
I go to bed at ten.

lines.zh: 这段独白是一天的完整描述。注意几个动词短语：get up 起床，wash my face 洗脸，brush my teeth 刷牙，have breakfast 吃早饭，go to school 去上学，do my homework 做作业，take a shower 洗澡，go to bed 上床睡觉。这些短语考试经常出现，一定要记熟。

lines.en: When do you usually get up, Li Ming?
I usually get up at six thirty. What about you?
I get up at seven. My school is near my home.
How do you go to school?
I walk to school. It takes me ten minutes.
That's nice. I take the bus. It takes about half an hour.
Do you have breakfast at home?
Yes, I do. My mother makes breakfast for me every day.
My mother is a doctor, so she goes to work very early. I make my own breakfast.
Wow, that's cool.

lines.zh: 这段对话讲的是起床时间和上学方式。交通方式的说法要记清楚：walk to school 走路，by bike 骑车，by bus 乘公交，by car 坐小汽车，by underground 坐地铁。注意，by 后面直接加交通工具，中间不加冠词。

lines.en: What do you usually do after school?
I usually play basketball with my friends. Sometimes I help my mother with housework.
Do you watch TV in the evening?
Not very often. I only watch TV on Saturday evening. What about you?
I help my little sister with her homework, and then I read English stories.
Reading is a good habit. When do you go to bed?
At about ten. My mother always says, early to bed and early to rise.
My mother says the same thing.

lines.zh: 最后这段对话里有句谚语，early to bed and early to rise，意思是早睡早起。帮助别人做某事用 help someone with something，比如 help my mother with housework，帮妈妈做家务。

lines.en: I get up at six thirty.
I brush my teeth and wash my face.
I go to school by bike.
It takes me twenty minutes.
I do my homework after dinner.
I go to bed at ten.

lines.zh: 跟着读一遍，注意 thirty 和 thirteen 的区别，一个是三十，一个是十三。
下面我们把刚才听过的内容放慢速度再放一遍，这次你可以跟着一起说。

lines.en: I get up at six thirty.
I brush my teeth every morning.
I go to school by bike.
It takes me twenty minutes.
I have lunch at school.
I help my mother with housework.
I take a shower before bed.
I go to bed at ten.
Early to bed and early to rise.
What do you usually do after school?

lines.zh: 小任务：请用五句英语描述你的一天，从起床说到睡觉。不用追求完美，能把时间点和动作说出来就很棒了。
第三集到这里。现在你已经能用英语讲一天的生活了。下一集我们去餐厅，学学怎么用英语点餐。我们下次见。

episodes.title: 点餐与饮食
episodes.desc: 在餐厅点菜、谈论食物与饮食习惯

lines.zh: 欢迎收听第四集，点餐与饮食。无论是在国内的西餐厅，还是以后出国旅行，会用英语点餐都非常实用。这一集我们还要聊聊健康的饮食习惯。

lines.en: Good evening. Table for two, please.
This way, please. Here is the menu.
Thank you. What would you like to eat, Anna?
I'd like some noodles. What about you?
I want to try the beef and rice. Are you ready to order?
Yes. Excuse me, we are ready to order.
What would you like?
I'd like the beef and rice, and a glass of orange juice.
And I'd like a bowl of noodles and a cup of tea.
Anything else?
No, thanks. That's all.

lines.zh: 点餐时最常用的是 I'd like，这是 I would like 的缩写，比 I want 更礼貌。想吃面条说 a bowl of noodles，一碗面条；想喝一杯茶说 a cup of tea；一杯果汁说 a glass of juice。量词不能混用，这是考点。

lines.en: How is the food, Anna?
It's delicious. I love Chinese food. It's my favourite.
I'm glad you like it. Would you like some more rice?
No, thanks. I'm full.
Let's have some fruit after the meal.
Good idea. Excuse me, could we have the bill, please?
Sure. Here you are. That's eighty yuan in all.
Here is the money. Keep the change.
Thank you. Have a nice day.

lines.zh: 吃完饭后，表示吃饱了说 I'm full。结账可以说 Could we have the bill, please，或者 ask for the bill。说食物好吃，除了 delicious，还可以用 tasty 或者 yummy。

lines.en: Let's talk about healthy eating.
We should eat more vegetables and fruit every day.
We should also drink enough water, about eight glasses a day.
We should not eat too much fast food, because it has a lot of fat and salt.
Breakfast is very important.
A good breakfast gives us energy for the whole morning.
Don't eat too much before you go to bed.
Remember, healthy food makes us strong and happy.

lines.zh: 这段讲的是健康饮食。should 表示应该，should not 表示不应该。记住几个词：vegetables 蔬菜，fruit 水果，fast food 快餐，energy 能量。

lines.en: I'd like a bowl of noodles.
What would you like to drink?
It's delicious.
I'm full. Thank you.
Could we have the bill, please?
We should eat more vegetables.

lines.zh: 跟着读一遍。注意 would you like 的连读，听起来像一个整体。
下面我们把刚才听过的内容放慢速度再放一遍，这次你可以跟着一起说。

lines.en: I'd like a bowl of noodles.
What would you like to drink?
Are you ready to order?
It's delicious.
I'm full.
Could we have the bill, please?
We should eat more vegetables.
Breakfast is very important.
Don't eat too much fast food.
Help yourself to some fish.

lines.zh: 小任务：假设你在餐厅，请用英语点一份主食和一份饮料。开头用 I'd like，试试看。
第四集到这里。下次去餐厅，可以试着用英语点一次餐。下一集我们去商店，学学怎么用英语购物和讨价还价。我们下次见。

episodes.title: 购物与价格
episodes.desc: 买东西、问价格、挑尺寸、付款

lines.zh: 欢迎收听第五集，购物与价格。买东西是日常生活里最常见的场景之一，也是中考听力的必考内容。这一集我们学怎么问价格、挑尺码和付款。

lines.en: Good morning. Can I help you?
Yes, please. I'm looking for a T-shirt.
What size do you want?
Size M, please. Do you have this one in blue?
Yes, here it is. Blue is very popular this year.
It looks nice. Can I try it on?
Sure. The fitting room is over there.
It fits me well. How much is it?
It's ninety-nine yuan.
That's a bit expensive. Do you have a cheaper one?
This white one is sixty-nine yuan. It's on sale.
OK, I'll take it.

lines.zh: 店员问你需要什么，常说 Can I help you 或者 What can I do for you。你想买什么，就说 I'm looking for 加上商品名。试穿用 try on，试衣间是 fitting room。问价格用 How much is it。

lines.en: Excuse me, how much are these apples?
They are eight yuan a kilo. How many kilos do you want?
Two kilos, please. Are they fresh?
Yes, they came this morning. Would you like some bananas? They are on sale today.
How much are the bananas?
Five yuan a kilo. They are very sweet.
OK, one kilo of bananas, please.
Anything else?
No, that's all. How much in all?
Twenty-one yuan. Cash or card?
I'll pay by phone. Here you are.
Thank you. Here is your change. Welcome back.

lines.zh: 买水果时，按重量说 eight yuan a kilo，就是八元一公斤。on sale 表示打折促销。付款方式，现金是 cash，刷卡是 card，手机支付可以说 pay by phone。找零是 change。

lines.en: Shopping online is very popular now.
It is easy and it saves time.
You can buy almost everything on the internet.
But there are some problems.
Sometimes the things are not as good as the pictures.
Sometimes the size is not right.
And you have to wait for two or three days.
When you shop online, remember to read the reviews first.
Reviews from other buyers can help you a lot.

lines.zh: 这段讲的是网购。online 是在线上，save time 节省时间，review 指买家的评价。买东西前看评价，是个好习惯。

lines.en: Can I help you?
I'm looking for a T-shirt.
Can I try it on?
How much is it?
It's too expensive. Do you have a cheaper one?
I'll take it.

lines.zh: 跟着读一遍。注意 try it on，代词 it 要放在 try 和 on 中间。
下面我们把刚才听过的内容放慢速度再放一遍，这次你可以跟着一起说。

lines.en: Can I help you?
I'm looking for a T-shirt.
What size do you want?
Can I try it on?
How much is it?
It's too expensive.
Do you have a cheaper one?
I'll take it.
It's on sale.
Here is your change.

lines.zh: 小任务：假设你在服装店，请用英语问价格，并说你觉得太贵了，想看便宜一点的。
第五集到这里。下一集我们聊聊天气和季节，这是英国人最爱聊的话题，也是中考听力的常客。我们下次见。

episodes.title: 天气与季节
episodes.desc: 描述天气、谈论四季与穿衣

lines.zh: 欢迎收听第六集，天气与季节。英语国家的人见面常常先聊天气，就像我们问你吃饭了吗。学会描述天气，你的口语会自然很多。

lines.en: There are four seasons in a year.
They are spring, summer, autumn and winter.
Spring is warm and it often rains.
Flowers come out and trees turn green.
Summer is hot and sunny.
We can swim in the sea and eat ice cream.
Autumn is cool and dry.
The leaves turn yellow and fall from the trees.
Winter is cold and it sometimes snows.
We wear thick coats and make snowmen.
My favourite season is autumn, because the weather is comfortable.

lines.zh: 这段独白讲了四季。注意季节前的介词用 in，比如 in spring，in winter。描述天气用 It is 加上形容词，比如 It is warm，It is rainy。注意 rain 是雨，rainy 是下雨的，一个是名词一个是形容词。

lines.en: What's the weather like today?
It's cloudy and a bit cold. The radio says it may rain this afternoon.
Really? I forgot to bring my umbrella.
Don't worry. You can use mine.
Thanks. What's the temperature today?
It's about fifteen degrees. The highest is eighteen.
That's much colder than yesterday. It was twenty-five yesterday.
Yes. Autumn is coming. I like this weather.

lines.zh: 问天气最常用 What's the weather like，也可以说 How is the weather。问温度用 What's the temperature，回答用 It's 加上数字和 degrees 度。比较级也要会用，colder than 就是比什么更冷。

lines.en: It's a beautiful day, isn't it?
Yes, it is. The sun is shining and there is no wind.
Let's go for a walk in the park.
Good idea. But the weather report says it will rain tomorrow.
Then let's go today. What should I wear?
A jacket is enough. It's not very cold outside.
OK. I will take my camera too. I want to take some photos.
Great. Don't forget your water bottle.

lines.zh: 这段对话里有反义疑问句，It's a beautiful day, isn't it，意思是今天天气真好，不是吗。这是英语里很常见的搭话方式，回答用 Yes, it is 或 No, it isn't。

lines.en: What's the weather like today?
It's sunny and warm.
It's raining outside.
What's the temperature?
It's fifteen degrees.
My favourite season is autumn.

lines.zh: 跟着读一遍。注意 temperature 的重音在第一个音节。
下面我们把刚才听过的内容放慢速度再放一遍，这次你可以跟着一起说。

lines.en: What's the weather like today?
It's sunny and warm.
It's raining heavily.
What's the temperature?
It's about fifteen degrees.
My favourite season is autumn.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢的季节是秋天。

lines.en: It's colder than yesterday.
Don't forget your umbrella.
The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
It's a beautiful day, isn't it?

lines.zh: 小任务：请用三句英语描述今天的天气，并说出你最喜欢的季节和原因。
第六集到这里。下一集我们聊聊兴趣爱好和运动，这是交朋友的好话题。我们下次见。

episodes.title: 兴趣与运动
episodes.desc: 聊爱好、约人运动、谈论比赛

lines.zh: 欢迎收听第七集，兴趣与运动。问别人有什么爱好，是交朋友最快的方式。这一集我们学怎么说自己的爱好，怎么约同学一起运动。

lines.en: What do you like doing in your free time?
I like reading and playing the piano. What about you?
I'm interested in sports, especially basketball.
How often do you play basketball?
Three times a week. I play with my classmates after school.
That's why you are so tall and strong.
Ha ha. Exercise makes me healthy. Do you want to join us this Friday?
I'd love to, but I have a piano lesson on Friday.
What a pity. Maybe next time.

lines.zh: 问爱好用 What do you like doing，也可以用 What's your hobby。表示对什么感兴趣，用 be interested in，后面加名词或者动词的 ing 形式。问频率用 How often，回答 three times a week 就是一周三次。

lines.en: There is a football match this Saturday. Would you like to go with me?
I'd love to. Which teams are playing?
Our school team and No. 3 Middle School. It starts at three in the afternoon.
Great. Where shall we meet?
Let's meet at the school gate at two thirty.
No problem. How much is the ticket?
It's free for students. And the weather will be fine.
Perfect. I will bring some water and my camera.
See you on Saturday. Don't be late.

lines.zh: 邀请别人用 Would you like to 加上动词原形，是最自然的说法。如果想去就说 I'd love to，如果去不了，先说 I'd love to，再用 but 说明原因，这样比较礼貌。约定见面地点用 Where shall we meet。

lines.en: Everyone should have a hobby.
A hobby makes our life interesting and helps us relax.
Some people like collecting things, such as stamps, coins or postcards.
Some people enjoy drawing, singing or dancing.
Others love outdoor activities like cycling, hiking and swimming.
If you don't have a hobby yet, why not try something new?
You can join a club at school.
You may find a hobby you really love.

lines.zh: 这段独白讲的是爱好的意义。relax 是放松，collect 是收集，outdoor activities 是户外活动。为什么不做某事，用 Why not 加动词原形，比如 Why not try something new，为什么不试试新东西呢。

lines.en: What's your hobby?
I'm interested in playing basketball.
How often do you exercise?
I play football twice a week.
Would you like to go with me?
I'd love to, but I'm busy.

lines.zh: 跟着读一遍。注意 interested 的发音，重音在第一个音节。
下面我们把刚才听过的内容放慢速度再放一遍，这次你可以跟着一起说。

lines.en: What's your hobby?
I like reading in my free time.
I'm interested in basketball.
How often do you exercise?
I play football twice a week.
Would you like to go with me?
I'd love to, but I'm busy.
Let's meet at the school gate.
Exercise makes me healthy.
Why not try something new?
lines.zh: 为什么不试试新东西呢？
小任务：请用英语说出你的一个爱好，多久做一次，以及你为什么喜欢它。
第七集到这里。下一集我们学问路和交通，出门在外非常实用。我们下次见。
欢迎收听第八集，问路与交通。在陌生的地方，能不能问到路非常重要。这一集我们学怎么礼貌地问路，怎么听懂别人的指引。

lines.en: Excuse me, could you tell me the way to the zoo?
Sure. Go along this street and turn left at the second crossing.
Turn left at the second crossing. And then?
You will see a bank on your right. The zoo is next to the bank.
Is it far from here?
No, it's about ten minutes' walk.
Can I take a bus there?
Yes, you can take the number five bus. Get off at the Zoo Stop.
Thank you very much.
You're welcome.

lines.zh: 问路开头一定要说 Excuse me，这是礼貌。最常用的一句是 Could you tell me the way to 加上地点。指路时常用的词有 go along 沿着走，turn left 左转，turn right 右转，at the crossing 在路口，next to 在旁边，opposite 在对面。

lines.en: Excuse me, how can I get to the railway station?
You can take the underground. The station is over there, across the road.
Which line should I take?
Take Line Two and get off at the Central Station. It's the fourth stop.
How long does it take?
About twenty minutes. A ticket costs four yuan.
Where can I buy a ticket?
You can buy it at the ticket office or use the machine over there.
Thank you. By the way, is there a toilet near here?
Yes, it's behind that tall building.

lines.zh: 第二段对话讲的是坐地铁。地铁在英国叫 underground 或者 tube，在美国叫 subway。几号线用 Line 加数字。How long does it take 问的是要花多长时间。

lines.en: In big cities, traffic can be very busy, especially in the morning and evening.
That time is called the rush hour.
Taking the underground is usually faster than taking a bus during the rush hour.
Many students ride a bike or walk to school, because it is good exercise.
Remember these safety rules.
Look left and right before you cross the road.
Always use the zebra crossing.
Never play on the road.

lines.zh: 这段讲的是交通与安全。rush hour 是高峰期，zebra crossing 是斑马线。过马路前要左右看，这是 Look left and right before you cross the road。

lines.en: Excuse me, how can I get to the museum?
Go along this street and turn right.
It's next to the bank.
Is it far from here?
You can take the number five bus.
Look left and right before you cross the road.

lines.zh: 跟着读一遍。注意 Excuse me 的语调，要客气一点。
下面我们把刚才听过的内容放慢速度再放一遍，这次你可以跟着一起说。

lines.en: Excuse me, could you tell me the way to the zoo?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，请问去动物园怎么走？

lines.en: Go along this street.
Turn left at the second crossing.
It's next to the bank.
Is it far from here?
You can take the number five bus.
How long does it take?
Get off at the Zoo Stop.
It's about ten minutes' walk.
Look left and right before you cross the road.

lines.zh: 小任务：请用英语告诉别人，怎么从你们学校走到最近的书店。试着用上 go along、turn left 和 next to。
第八集到这里。下一集我们说说健康和看医生，这是很实用的生活场景。我们下次见。

episodes.title: 健康与就医
episodes.desc: 描述症状、看医生、给建议

lines.zh: 欢迎收听第九集，健康与就医。身体不舒服的时候，能用英语说清楚症状非常重要。这一集我们学怎么描述不舒服，怎么听懂医生的建议。

lines.en: Good morning. What's the matter with you?
I don't feel well. I have a headache and a fever.
How long have you been like this?
Since yesterday evening. I couldn't sleep well last night.
Let me take your temperature. Do you have a cough?
Yes, a little. And I have a sore throat.
Open your mouth and say ah. You have a cold, but it's not serious.
What should I do, doctor?
Take this medicine three times a day. Drink more water and have a good rest.
Thank you, doctor. Do I need to stay at home?
Yes, stay at home for two days. You will get better soon.

lines.zh: 医生问你怎么了，常说 What's the matter 或者 What's wrong with you。描述症状：have a headache 头疼，have a fever 发烧，have a cough 咳嗽，have a sore throat 嗓子疼。注意，表示生病用 have a 加病名，但牙疼是 have a toothache，胃疼是 have a stomachache。

lines.en: You look tired, Li Ming. Are you all right?
I'm a bit tired these days. I go to bed very late.
Why? Do you have too much homework?
Yes. And I play computer games every evening.
You should stop doing that. It's bad for your eyes and your study.
You are right. What should I do?
You should go to bed before ten and do some exercise every day.
OK, I will try. Thanks for your advice.

lines.zh: 给建议用 You should 加动词原形，不应该用 You shouldn't。对什么有害，用 be bad for；对什么有益，用 be good for。比如 It's bad for your eyes，这对你的眼睛不好。

lines.en: How can we keep healthy?
Here is some advice.
First, eat healthy food.
Try to eat more fruit and vegetables every day.
Second, get enough sleep.
Teenagers need about nine hours of sleep a night.
Third, exercise for at least one hour a day.
You can run, swim or play ball games.
Fourth, wash your hands before meals and after using the toilet.
Finally, keep happy.
A happy heart is the best medicine.

lines.zh: 这段讲的是保持健康的建议。at least 是至少，teenager 是青少年，最后一句 A happy heart is the best medicine，意思是快乐的心是最好的药。

lines.en: What's the matter with you?
I have a headache and a fever.
How long have you been like this?
Take this medicine three times a day.
You should have a good rest.
It's bad for your eyes.

lines.zh: 跟着读一遍。注意 headache 的发音，head 加 ache，ache 读作 k 的音。
下面我们把刚才听过的内容放慢速度再放一遍，这次你可以跟着一起说。

lines.en: What's the matter with you?
I have a headache.
I have a fever.
I have a sore throat.
How long have you been like this?
Take this medicine three times a day.
You should have a good rest.
Drink more water.
It's bad for your eyes.
You will get better soon.

lines.zh: 小任务：假设你感冒了，请用三句英语向医生说清你的症状。
第九集到这里。祝你身体健康。下一集我们聊聊节假日，学怎么用英语介绍中国的传统节日。我们下次见。

episodes.title: 节日与假期
episodes.desc: 春节、中秋、生日与假期计划

lines.zh: 欢迎收听第十集，节日与假期。向外国朋友介绍中国的传统节日，是初中英语写作的经典题目。这一集我们学怎么说春节、中秋节和生日。

lines.en: The Spring Festival is the most important festival in China.
It usually comes in January or February.
Before the festival, people clean their houses and buy lots of food.
On New Year's Eve, families get together and have a big dinner.
We eat dumplings and watch the Spring Festival Gala on TV.
Children are very happy because they can get lucky money in red packets.
During the festival, people visit their relatives and friends.
They say Happy New Year to each other.

lines.zh: 这段介绍了春节。几个重点词：New Year's Eve 除夕，get together 聚会，dumplings 饺子，lucky money 压岁钱，red packet 红包，relatives 亲戚。注意 relatives 是亲戚，不是关系。

lines.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is coming. Do you have any plans?
Yes. My family will get together and eat mooncakes.
I love mooncakes. Why do people eat them on that day?
Because the moon is round and bright on that day. Mooncakes are round too.
What else do people do?
They sit outside, enjoy the full moon and tell stories about Chang'e.
That sounds interesting. Will you watch the moon this year?
Of course. My grandmother will tell us old stories again. I love her stories.

lines.zh: 中秋节是 Mid-Autumn Festival，月饼是 mooncake，满月是 full moon。嫦娥的故事是考试常考的文化点，英文里写作 Chang'e。

lines.en: Happy birthday, Anna! This is a gift for you.
Thank you, Li Ming. You are so kind. Can I open it now?
Sure, go ahead.
Wow, it's a beautiful notebook. I like it very much.
I'm glad you like it. Make a wish and blow out the candles.
OK. I wish everyone here good health and happiness.
Let's cut the cake and sing the birthday song together.
Thank you all. This is the best birthday ever.

lines.zh: 生日祝福说 Happy birthday。送礼物用 This is a gift for you。许愿是 make a wish，吹蜡烛是 blow out the candles。收到礼物要表示感谢，这是英语国家的习惯。

lines.en: Happy New Year!
The Spring Festival is coming.
We eat dumplings on New Year's Eve.
Children can get lucky money.
We enjoy the full moon on Mid-Autumn Day.
Happy birthday to you!

lines.zh: 跟着读一遍。注意 festival 的重音在第一个音节。
下面我们把刚才听过的内容放慢速度再放一遍，这次你可以跟着一起说。

lines.en: Happy New Year!
The Spring Festival is coming.
We have a big dinner on New Year's Eve.
Children can get lucky money.
We eat mooncakes and enjoy the full moon.
Happy birthday to you!
This is a gift for you.
Make a wish and blow out the candles.
People visit their relatives and friends.
We say Happy New Year to each other.

lines.zh: 小任务：请用三到五句英语，向外国朋友介绍春节。可以从时间、食物和活动说起。
第十集到这里。下一集我们聊聊旅行和计划，学怎么用英语安排一次出行。我们下次见。

episodes.title: 旅行与计划
episodes.desc: 订酒店、买票、制定旅行计划

lines.zh: 欢迎收听第十一集，旅行与计划。假期快到的时候，大家都爱聊打算去哪儿。这一集我们学怎么用英语说计划、订票和描述一次旅行。

lines.en: The summer holiday is coming. What are you going to do?
I'm going to visit Xi'an with my parents. We will stay there for five days.
That sounds great. How are you going there?
We are going by high-speed train. It's fast and comfortable.
Have you booked the tickets?
Yes, my father booked them online last week. What about your plan?
I'm going to stay at home and read some books. Maybe I will visit my grandparents.
That's nice too. Please give my best wishes to them.

lines.zh: 说计划最常用 be going to 加动词原形，比如 I'm going to visit Xi'an。也可以用 will 加动词原形，比如 We will stay there for five days。高铁是 high-speed train，订票用 book，比如 book a ticket。

lines.en: Good afternoon. I'd like to book a single room for two nights.
Sure. Which dates, please?
From July the tenth to July the twelfth.
Let me check. Yes, we have a room on the fifth floor. It's three hundred yuan a night.
Does it include breakfast?
Yes, breakfast is included. It is served from seven to nine.
Good. Is there free wifi in the room?
Yes, the password is on the card. Here is your key.
Thank you. Where is the lift?
Just over there, next to the front desk.

lines.zh: 订酒店时，a single room 是单人间，a double room 是双人间。住两晚说 for two nights。include 是包含，早餐包含在内就是 breakfast is included。电梯在英国说 lift，在美国说 elevator。

lines.en: Last summer I went to Hangzhou with my family.
We went there by train.
The journey took about six hours.
We stayed in a small hotel near the West Lake.
On the first day we walked around the lake and took many photos.
On the second day we visited a tea village and learned how to make tea.
The weather was hot but we were very happy.
I think travelling is the best way to learn about the world.

lines.zh: 这段独白描述了一次旅行。注意描述过去的旅行要用过去式：go 变成 went，take 变成 took，stay 变成 stayed。journey 是旅程。

lines.en: What are you going to do this summer?
I'm going to visit Xi'an.
We will stay there for five days.
I'd like to book a single room.
Does it include breakfast?
We took many photos there.

lines.zh: 跟着读一遍。注意 going to 在口语里常读成 gonna 的音。
下面我们把刚才听过的内容放慢速度再放一遍，这次你可以跟着一起说。

lines.en: What are you going to do?
I'm going to visit Xi'an.
We will stay there for five days.
How are you going there?
I'd like to book a single room.
Does it include breakfast?
Have a good trip!
The journey took six hours.
We took many photos.
Travelling is the best way to learn.
lines.zh: 旅行是最好的学习方式。
小任务：请用英语说说你这个假期打算去哪儿，怎么去，待多久，做什么。
第十一集到这里。下一集是最后一集，我们聊聊动物和环境保护。我们下次见。

episodes.title: 动物与环境
episodes.desc: 谈论动物、描述环保行动

lines.zh: 欢迎收听第十二集，动物与环境。这是中考写作的高频话题，也是我们每个人都应该关心的事。这一集我们学怎么描述动物，怎么谈环保。

lines.en: Animals are our friends.
My favourite animal is the panda.
Pandas live in the mountains of Sichuan.
They are black and white.
They eat bamboo every day and they sleep a lot.
Pandas are in danger because people cut down too many trees.
We should protect them and their homes.
Many people work hard to save pandas.
Now there are more pandas in the wild.

lines.zh: 这段介绍大熊猫。几个重点表达：in danger 处于危险中，cut down 砍伐，protect 保护，in the wild 在野外。描述动物可以从居住地、外形、食物和习性说起。

lines.en: Look at this photo. This is my dog, Coco.
She is so cute. How old is she?
She is two years old. She is very friendly and clever.
What can she do?
She can sit, stand and shake hands. She can also bring me my shoes.
Amazing! Do you take her for a walk every day?
Yes, I walk her after dinner. It's good exercise for both of us.
I want a dog too, but my mother says no. She says it takes too much time.

lines.zh: 这段对话讲宠物。描述动物性格可以用 friendly 友好的，clever 聪明的，lovely 可爱的，lazy 懒惰的。遛狗是 take the dog for a walk，或者简单说 walk the dog。

lines.en: Our environment is facing many problems.
The air in some cities is not clean.
The water in some rivers is dirty.
There is too much rubbish on the streets and in the sea.
What can we do?
We can do many small things every day.
We should turn off the lights when we leave a room.
We should save water and put rubbish in the right bin.
We can ride a bike or take a bus instead of going by car.
We can plant more trees.
If everyone does a little, the world will be much better.

lines.zh: 这段讲的是环保。几个必背表达：turn off 关掉，save water 节约用水，rubbish 垃圾，plant trees 植树，instead of 而不是。最后一句，如果每个人都做一点，世界会好很多。

lines.en: My favourite animal is the panda.
Pandas are in danger.
We should protect animals.
We should save water.
Turn off the lights when you leave.
Don't throw rubbish everywhere.

lines.zh: 跟着读一遍。注意 rubbish 的发音，中间是双 b。
下面我们把刚才听过的内容放慢速度再放一遍，这次你可以跟着一起说。

lines.en: My favourite animal is the panda.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢的动物是熊猫。

lines.en: Pandas are in danger.
We should protect wild animals.
lines.zh: 我们应该保护野生动物。

lines.en: People cut down too many trees.
We should save water.
Turn off the lights when you leave.
Don't throw rubbish everywhere.
We should put rubbish in the bin.
lines.zh: 我们应该把垃圾扔进垃圾桶。

lines.en: Planting more trees is good for the earth.
If everyone does a little, the world will be better.
lines.zh: 如果每个人都做一点，世界会更好。
小任务：请用三句英语说说你能为保护环境做什么。可以从节约用水、关灯、不乱扔垃圾说起。
第十二集到这里，也是这个系列的第一季最后一集。我们从问候聊到了环保，一共十二个最常考的话题。感谢你的收听，希望这些句子能陪你走得更远。祝你学习进步，天天开心。

episodes.title: 问候与介绍
episodes.desc: 怎样用英语打招呼、介绍自己和别人

lines.zh: 大家好，欢迎收听初中英语散步播客。第一集，我们来学最基础的问候与介绍。这是每段英语对话的第一步。你会听到三段小对话，然后是实用的重点句子。不用着急，边走边听，能听懂多少算多少。

lines.en: Hello! My name is Li Ming. What's your name?
Hi, Li Ming. My name is Anna. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you too, Anna. Are you a new student here?
Yes, I am. I'm in Class Two, Grade Seven.
Really? I'm in Class Two too. We are classmates.
That's great. I'm very happy to be here.
Welcome to our class, Anna.
Thank you, Li Ming.

lines.zh: 第一段对话里，两个人第一次见面。最常用的一句话是 Nice to meet you，回答是 Nice to meet you too。注意 too 放在句子末尾，表示也。问对方名字用 What's your name，回答用 My name is 加上你的名字，或者简单说 I'm Li Ming。

lines.en: Good morning, Mr. Wang. How are you today?
Good morning, Li Ming. I'm fine, thank you. And you?
I'm fine too. This is my friend, Anna. She is from Canada.
Nice to meet you, Anna. Welcome to our school.
Nice to meet you too, Mr. Wang. Your school is very beautiful.
Mr. Wang is our English teacher. He is very kind.
Thank you, Li Ming. See you in class.
See you, Mr. Wang.

lines.zh: 第二段对话里出现了介绍别人的句子。介绍别人用 This is 加上名字，比如 This is my friend, Anna。对老师要用 Mr. 先生、Miss 小姐或者 Mrs. 女士加上姓氏，这是英语里的礼貌习惯。How are you 是熟人之间问你好吗，最常见的回答是 I'm fine, thank you。

lines.en: Let me tell you something about greetings in English.
In the morning we say Good morning.
In the afternoon we say Good afternoon.
In the evening we say Good evening.
At night, when we go to bed, we say Good night.
Good night is only for leaving, not for meeting someone.
When you meet a friend, you can say Hello, Hi, or How's it going.
When you leave, you can say Goodbye, Bye, See you, or See you tomorrow.

lines.zh: 这段独白讲的是早中晚的问候语。要特别记住，Good night 只在睡前或分别时说，晚上见到人要说 Good evening。这是很多同学会弄混的地方。

lines.en: Good morning, Miss Li.
How are you today?
I'm fine, thank you. And you?
This is my friend, Anna.
Nice to meet you.
See you tomorrow.

lines.zh: 刚才这几个句子，是最常用的问候语。跟着一起读，读慢一点，把每个音发清楚。
下面我们把刚才听过的内容放慢速度再放一遍，这次你可以跟着一起说。

lines.en: Nice to meet you.
What's your name?
My name is Li Ming.
This is my friend, Anna.
I'm in Class Two, Grade Seven.
How are you?
I'm fine, thank you.
Welcome to our class.
See you tomorrow.
Good night.

lines.zh: 现在轮到你开口了。请用英语回答：如果你的新同学对你说 Nice to meet you，你应该怎么回答？想好了就大声说出来，散步的时候不用担心说错。
第一集就到这里。今天我们学了问候和介绍。记住，说英语最重要的是开口，说错了也没关系。下一集，我们聊聊学校生活。祝你散步愉快，我们下次见。
